summary: Verified partial production fix: the candidate fixes get_hf_text_config and compressed-tensors linear_fp8_config null handling, but issue-named Muse Glimmer and ModelOpt paths still distinguish null from missing and raise internal AttributeError exceptions.

tests.what_was_measured: Independent per-case harness reproduced the MiniMax text_config=None AssertionError and compressed-tensors linear_fp8_config=None AttributeError while their missing-section controls succeeded. The harness catches per-case exceptions, so process exit 0 is expected.
Candidate regression suite: 76 passed and 2 subtests passed.
The unchanged independent harness confirmed both base failures pass at the exact candidate commit.

Per-case harness found remaining Muse Glimmer text_config=None and ModelOpt quantization=None AttributeErrors compared with their missing-section controls. The harness catches per-case exceptions, so process exit 0 is expected.
Candidate diff contains no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X was visible through PyTorch/ROCm, but no GPU kernel was executed because the defect and counterexamples are CPU-side config parsing.

remaining_counterexamples: muse_glimmer_config_kwargs_from_hf treats a missing text_config as acceptable but dereferences text_config=None with None.items().
ModelOptFp8Config.from_config gives a descriptive ValueError when quantization is missing but dereferences quantization=None with None.get().
remaining_limitations: No RedHatAI/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-FP8 weights were provided, so the live-server reproduction was not run.
The available AMD Instinct MI355X/ROCm environment differs from the reporter's RTX 4090/CUDA environment and the task's stated gfx950 assignment.
No full-model serving, semantic-accuracy, or distributed-workload claim is made.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes only Python and tests.
